maya: Quick sync — payments asked for a per-API-key override so their reconciliation worker can run sustained 800 QPS. Do we have an agreed policy for internal/service keys?
ben: Hmm. We have to be careful about special-casing keys. "system" keys are fine but need clear limits + monitoring. unlimited burst is dangerous.
samir: +1. Proposal: two explicit scopes — `system` (internal infra/service) and `partner` (third-party integrations). Each scope gets a defined sustained QPS and a burst budget. Overrides must expire and be auditable.
elaine: Do we have an audit path for when someone requests an override? need owner, ticket id, and review. Also: KMS note — these keys should stay in the same rotation policy.
ops-bot: created ticket INFPLAT-3212 for "API key override workflow" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFPLAT-3212 :white_check_mark:
jordan: Implementation plan idea: extend quota-service to accept `key_scope` and `override` metadata on a per-key rule. Default behavior: no special privileges unless `override.approved=true` and `override.expires_at` set. Example rule:
```yaml
# example override payload
overrides:
  - key_id: svc-payments-recon
    scope: system
    sustained_qps: 800
    burst_tokens: 1200
    expires_at: "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"
    meta: { owner: "payments-team", ticket: "INF-1234" }
```
ben: Nice. Telemetry checklist: surface per-key QPS, 95th latency, error-rate, and a per-key cost estimate. Add an alert if actual sustained QPS > configured sustained_qps for >5min.
samir: We should also label these keys in the console UI and allow searching/filtering by `override.*` fields. Rollout: start with opt-in for payments and internal-analytics, not partners.
elaine: Security checklist: require an approver from sec or infra for any `sustained_qps` > 500. Also enforce MFA and log export for overrides.
maya: Sounds like consensus. Can we get a minimal rollout plan?
jordan: I'll open a PR against quotas-service and a tiny console flag to show override badges. Timeline: PR this week, internal canary next week (payments only), broader opt-in after 2 weeks of stable metrics. Assigning reviewers: @ben for SLOs, @elaine for compliance.
ben: I'll draft the SLO/alert playbook.
elaine: I'll add the approval flow to the INFPLAT-3212 ticket and add sec review requirement.
maya: Thanks all — pls keep updates in the ticket. If we need an emergency rollback, we should have a kill-switch on policy matching `scope: system`.
ops-bot: INFPLAT-3212 updated: reviewer=elaine, assignees=jordan,ben; status=In Progress
ben: :thumbsup:
